heading: Extension of period of limitation in certain cases.
text: Notwithstanding anything contained in the foregoing provisions of this Chapter, any Court may take cognizance of an offence after the expiry of the period of limitation, if it is satisfied on the facts and in the circumstances of the case that the delay has been properly explained or that it is necessary so to do in the interests of justice.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
